* '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Block 1 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009 (slip 118)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on Han or a Lars. Character cannot be targeted by [Permanent Weapon] weapons or be captured. If just lost, place this device in Used Pile. Force loss from Or Be Destroyed must come from Reserve Deck (if possible) and may not be reduced below 2.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-118-Tatooine_Utility_Belt.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-L-tatooineutilitybelt-pre.gif]]) print it. The Master List (Light Side p. 20)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> reprints it character for character: a stale reprint, not a new version, and it does not make this text current again.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Tatooine Utility Belt (V) (Errata)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 1 list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1210_116">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock1Type (Virtual Block 1 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205209/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142851/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “Deploy on Han or a Lars. Character cannot be targeted by [Permanent Weapon] weapons or be captured. If just lost, place this device in Used Pile. Force loss from ...Or Be Destroyed must come from Reserve Deck (if possible) and may not be reduced below 2.” '''What changed:''' Three dots are added before “Or Be Destroyed” (“from Or Be Destroyed” becomes “from ...Or Be Destroyed”), as the Decipher card prints that half of its title. The same wording is already in the Players Committee's Holotable card data of 29 May 2010<ref name="cdf-1210_116">[https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/5047de0/db/lightside.cdf Holotable card data file, version 29 May 2010] (Players Committee data, copy on GitHub). Card data is dating evidence only, not a card document.</ref>. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes.
